# dsh-models
## 实际效果 / Actual UI
**推理层级 / Reasoning Effort**
**子代理路由 / Subagent Routing**
**主模型选择 / Main Model Picker**
## In one line

The model menu for the dsh web GUI — pick the model, its effort, and your
subagents' model, all from
the composer's model seat.
## What it is

A renamed, maintained fork of
ttmouse/dsh-model-picker
(v1.18.0 baseline). The upstream picker repla

ces the composer's model seat
with a search-first popup; this fork keeps that and adds the pieces a
multi-model daily driver needs.
A **three-zone trigger button** splits three concerns into three popups:
| Zone | Click | Popup content |
| **Left** (model name) | Opens the model picker | Search box (auto-focused), provider column, model

list with price badges and `dim` discovery rows |
| **Middle** (subagent icon) | Opens the subagent

picker | Per-session model override for subagents (depth ≥ 1) |
| **Right** (effort) | Opens the ef
fort picker | Available reasoning-effort levels |

Plus a settings-page 「模型选择」 card: discovery master switch,
ignore/restore for discovered models, hid

den-model management — linked live
with the picker.
## Fork attribution

Upstream: ttmouse/dsh-model-picker
(MIT). This repo renames the package to `dsh-models` and maintain

s the
enhanced build (subagent routing, `dim` bridge, settings card, zh/en locale,
custom background

color, theme readability fixes). Routes
(`/api/model-picker/…`) and `dsh.modelPicker.*` storage key

s keep their
upstream names so existing preferences migrate seamlessly.
## Install

Requires harness ≥ 0.2.0-rc.1 (verified on 0.2.0-rc.2; also running on
0.2.1-alpha.3).

## Compatibility
| dsh-models | Harness | Notes |
| 0.1.4 | **0.2.1-alpha.3 (current, running)** | Virtualized model list + dim refresh throttle; seat

and route surfaces unchanged. |
| 0.1.0 | 0.2.0-rc.2 (measured) | Code-identical to the enhanced bu
ild running in production; client resolves against the official 0.2.0 slot roster. |
Requires Node.js ≥ 22.19 (the floor the picker is developed and tested on).
What was actually checked on 0.2.0-rc.2 (this code, pre-rename build):

- **Surfaces still resolve**: `conversation.input.model`, `web-ui.plugin.item`;
every icon used exis

ts in the official browser roster.
- **Seats that died upstream are avoided**: the alpha.2-removed
`

settings.plugin.item` seat is not used; the settings card renders as a
plain section (no `locale` fi

eld — a localized seat entry renders invisible).
- **Server settings channel is dead on current host

s** (`scope.set()`
resolves false), so card preferences live in `localStorage`
(`dsh.modelPicker.*`
+ cross-tab event) instead of `webUiSettings`.
## Configuration

No host-side config knobs yet — the bundle entry carries no `config` block.
User preferences (discov

ery switch, ignored/discovered models, hidden models,
background color, per-session subagent routes)

are managed from the
settings-page card and the picker itself.
## The `dim` bridge (optional)

When a `dim` CLI is present (`dim` on `PATH` or `~/.local/bin/dim`), the host
merges its catalog int

o the model facts: price badges, `maxOut`/`released`
facts, and discovery rows for models `dim` know

s that the dsh directory does
not (capped at 30 per provider, newest first). Without `dim` the picke

r works
exactly like upstream — the bridge degrades to directory-only facts.
## Tests & performance

- **`npm test`** — two pure-Node suites: `scripts/host-route.mjs` drives the
real route handlers (fa

cts cache, subagent route, error guards),
`scripts/interaction.mjs` renders the picker in jsdom and

drives
open/search/favorite/effort/virtual-window — 92 checks total. They SKIP
cleanly when the harn

ess peer deps are absent, so the suite stays green on
any machine.
- **Non-blocking cold start** — a

cold `/api/model-picker/models` cache answers
a fast 503 while the catalog refresh runs in the back

ground (measured: first
response ~3 ms, warm 200 within ~3 s); the client retries that 503 with
back

off, so price badges appear as soon as the facts land. Warm caches are
served stale-while-revalidate

.
- **Virtualized list** — the popup mounts only the rows around the viewport
(~13 of 310 live) and

pads the remainder with two spacer divs, so total
height, the scrollbar and every offset stay exact;

the section label of the
group the list stands in is pinned by a synthetic twin once its real heade

r
leaves the window. Measured live in the running web GUI: **open 58.7 → 23.5
ms median, 310 → 13 ro

ws mounted, 5506 → 1170 DOM nodes**; in the real-
browser bench, cumulative React render across a fu

ll interaction session
**243 → 65 ms**. Row heights follow whether a row shows its description line

(38/50 px), so the scroll math never re-lays-out. The host's `dim` refresh
went 60 s → 10 min — a mo

del catalog that turns over in days no longer costs
~1.5 s of CPU per minute. Full details in the
CH

log that turns over in days no longer costs
~1.5 s of CPU per minute. Full details in the
CHANGELOG.
